description: This file defines the Error controller class for the OpenCart admin startup process, handling PHP errors and exceptions by setting custom handlers.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Controller class for handling PHP errors and exceptions during startup in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Registers custom error and exception handlers.
